name: print-tracker
description: Tooling for print-tracker. The deployed app is public/ and has no build step; these scripts render icons, generate the in-app patch notes from CHANGELOG.md, and run the accessibility gate.

scripts.check: npm run --silent docs && npm run --silent privacy && npm run --silent quotes && npm run --silent thirdperson && npm run --silent pins && npm run --silent pwa && npm run --silent palette && npm run --silent icons && npm run --silent shell && npm run --silent fromurl && npm run --silent social && npm run --silent textsize && npm run --silent notes:check && npm run --silent voice && npm run --silent interactions && npm run --silent a11y && npm run --silent backup && npm run --silent update

//browser: playwright-core 1.56.0 ships chromium revision 1194, which matches /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194 in the session sandbox. These are a MATCHED PAIR: the a11y gate launches that hardcoded executablePath when it exists, and a playwright-core expecting a different revision connects and then hangs on a protocol mismatch with no error. If the sandbox browser changes, re-pin here and re-verify. CI has no such path and downloads its own matching build.
